title: Pittsburgh billboard
slide_intent: Reduce a message to a few readable elements because large outdoor placements are encountered quickly and from a distance.
strategic_value: The Pittsburgh reference, large wordmark and running character can connect Duolingo’s local roots with its learning mission.
demonstration: A green billboard above a building pairs a two-line statement about the future starting in Pittsburgh with a large wordmark, app badges and running figure.
practical_value: Judge headline length, signature size and illustration scale against an outdoor viewing context.

content_islands.name: Billboard message
content_islands.spec: Place the short white statement and signature on the left of the green board.

content_islands.name: Character
content_islands.spec: Place the running illustrated figure at right, extending to the lower edge.

content_islands.name: Built context
content_islands.spec: Retain the roof, board frame and sky around the installation.

reference_purposes.Application: The billboard demonstrates the identity in a large outdoor format with a location-specific message.
